Container.Name: OmniLink-AI
Container.Overview: OmniLink AI is an intelligent, self-hosted knowledge repository and link curation hub. Powered by Gemini 3.7 Flash, native SQLite with hybrid BM25 + dense vector semantic search, offline Readability markdown archiving, multi-platform scrapers (GitHub, Reddit, YouTube, X, Papers), Chrome Extension, PWA Mobile Quick Share, and built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
Container.Description: Intelligent, private link repository with AI extraction, hybrid search, offline reader mode, and multi-device ingress.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to OmniLink AI Web UI and REST API

Config.Name: AppData Storage Path
Config.Description: Persistent directory for SQLite database (omnilink.db), WAL files, and vector indices

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Google Gemini API Key for AI link parsing, auto-tagging, and RAG Q&A (get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com)

Config.Name: App Public URL
Config.Description: Public base URL or domain (e.g., https://links.yourdomain.com) for Web Share Target and mobile shortcuts

Config.Name: OmniLink Mode
Config.Description: Use local for loopback-only login-free mode, or multi-user only with complete OIDC and quota configuration

Config.Name: Bind Host
Config.Description: Listener bind address. Use 0.0.0.0 only when OMNILINK_MODE=multi-user is configured

Config.Name: Application Origin
Config.Description: Exact HTTPS browser origin, for example https://omnilink.example.com

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer
Config.Description: OIDC issuer URL, for example https://accounts.google.com

Config.Name: OIDC Discovery URL
Config.Description: Optional OIDC discovery URL when it differs from the issuer

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: OIDC application client ID

Config.Name: OIDC Audience
Config.Description: Expected ID-token audience, normally the OIDC client ID

Config.Name: OIDC Redirect URI
Config.Description: Exact registered callback URL ending in /auth/callback

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: OIDC confidential-client secret

Config.Name: OIDC Token Auth Method
Config.Description: Use client_secret_post, client_secret_basic, or none to match the provider registration

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: At least 32 random characters; keep stable across restarts and never commit

Config.Name: Session Store
Config.Description: Persistent session store. SQLite requires the AppData volume above

Config.Name: Monthly AI Quota Units
Config.Description: Positive model-weighted monthly AI usage limit; required in multi-user mode

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Node runtime environment mode

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal application listening port

Config.Name: Auto Backup Interval
Config.Description: Interval (in days) for automatic SQLite database backups in /app/data/backups
